findings.reason: A 400 m sprint is locomotion driven entirely by the athlete's own mass; resistance_source is already stored as bodyweight_leverage, so bodyweight=false contradicts the exercise and its own biomechanics row.
Alternating forward/backward lunge steps are a dynamic bodyweight movement; there is no external isometric resistance.

Stored tracking is bodyweight_plus_weight / added_weight / bodyweight_aware and resistance_source is bodyweight_leverage; the trunk is lifted by bodyweight with a barbell as added load, so bodyweight=false contradicts every other stored attribute.
tracking_type is bodyweight_reps with no equipment and no external load; total_load has nothing to refer to.
Resistance comes from the athlete's own body angle against a raised surface, exactly the bodyweight_leverage case used elsewhere in the catalogue for equivalent movements.
unilateral=true; every other strictly one-arm entry in the sample stores separate. One implement per side cannot be logged bilaterally.
unilateral=true single-arm cable raise; sides must be logged separately as in the catalogue's other one-arm entries.
unilateral=true one-arm cable press; side_mode optional contradicts the unilateral flag.
resistance_source bodyweight_leverage, tracking bodyweight_reps / bodyweight_aware and no load-bearing equipment; the crunch is a pure bodyweight movement.
The defining feature of the incline curl is shoulder extension placing the long head in a stretched position under load at the bottom; tension in the lengthened position cannot be low.
A side plank is held on one side with the fly performed by the free arm; the movement cannot be executed bilaterally in one set.
In a bent-over (kickback-style) extension the resistance moment arm is largest with the forearm horizontal at full elbow extension, i.e. the shortened position; the stored profile is inverted.
A concentration curl braces one arm against the thigh; side_mode is already stored as separate, contradicting unilateral=false.
Prone on a ball rotating one free leg, tracked by time with comparison_scope bodyweight_aware and no external load; bodyweight=false contradicts the movement.
The stored description states 'Unilateral press ... from a half-kneeling position'; unilateral=false, side_mode none and load_input_mode total_load all contradict it.
Running in place with no implement; resistance_source is already bodyweight_leverage.
Jumping through a rope carries no external load; resistance_source is bodyweight_leverage.
Calisthenics compression lift with resistance_source bodyweight_leverage and tracking bodyweight_reps / bodyweight_aware; bodyweight=false contradicts them all.
The description explicitly states added weight on the back and equipment is a dip_belt, but load_input_mode is none, so the added load can never be recorded.
The exercise is a static hold at lockout; there are no repetitions to count, duration under load is the measured variable.

non_vocabulary_findings.problem: rectus_abdominis is stored as the only PRIMARY muscle of a 400 m sprint while quadriceps and gastrocnemius are secondary and the hip extensors (gluteus maximus, hamstrings) are absent entirely; the involvement roles contradict sprint mechanics. Equipment is 'treadmill' for a track sprint.
Equipment lists only pull_up_bar: the assisting resistance band that defines the exercise is missing, and load_input_mode 'added_weight' describes the opposite of band assistance.

The description states the target is the upper pectoralis, but only pectoralis_major_sternal is stored; pectoralis_major_clavicular (which exists in the muscle vocabulary and is the incline-specific head) is absent, and deltoid_anterior is promoted to primary alongside the pec.

trapezius_middle is stored as a PRIMARY mover of an overhead carry (the relevant scapular muscles are upper trapezius and serratus anterior), and movement_pattern includes vertical_press although nothing is pressed - the load is held statically.
Equipment is 'treadmill' for an upper-body arm ergometer, and movement_pattern is 'locomotion' although the legs do not move.
Equipment is 'box_plyo' for running in place, which requires no equipment.
Equipment is 'cable_attachment_rope' for a standing bodyweight stretch that uses no equipment; kinetic_chain is null while the movement is a weight-bearing standing position.
Equipment is 'cable_attachment_rope' instead of a jump rope.

kinetic_chain is 'open' for a barbell squat; the feet are fixed to the ground and the body moves around them, which is the textbook closed-chain case (every other squat in the sample is stored closed).
Equipment is 'back_extension_machine' for a dedicated neck flexion machine.
Equipment is 'rowing_machine' for a ski ergometer; the equipment vocabulary appears to have no ski-erg entry, so the stored fact is simply the wrong machine.

Joint action stores shoulder.horizontal_adduction as primary for a bench dip, whose shoulder motion is sagittal-plane extension/flexion; pectoralis_major_sternal is also ranked primary ahead of the triceps in an exercise named and described as a triceps dip.
Equipment is 'cable_attachment_rope' although the described implement is a stretching strap; kinetic_chain is null for a standing weight-bearing stretch.

Latissimus dorsi is absent entirely and the movement is modelled as an isolated elbow flexion (biceps and forearm flexors primary, single elbow.flexion action) although joint_class is multi_joint; the front lever curl is a lat-dominated horizontal pull. kinetic_chain is 'open' although the hands are fixed on the bar and the body moves.
Equipment lists pull_up_bar and dip_bars for an exercise described as performed with the feet against a wall.
Equipment is 'foam_roller' for a wrist-roller device.
